name: io.github.frankbongo/thedisclist
title: TheDiscList Public MCP
description: Read-only disc golf flight data and weekly regional ranking comparisons.

tools.name: search_discs
tools.description: Search and filter disc golf discs by text query, brand, category, speed/glide range, stability score range, flight tag, and canonical flight class. Returns up to 50 bounded results with stable IDs and canonical URLs.

query.description: Text query to match disc name, brand, model, or slug

category.description: Filter by disc category (putter, midrange, fairway_driver, distance_driver)

tag.description: Filter by flight tag (e.g. 'Lockdown Fade', 'True Flight', 'Progressive Turn', 'Early Turn', 'Assured Fade')

is_ranked.description: If true, only return discs currently holding a global Top 100 sales ranking

limit.description: Maximum number of discs to return (1..50, default 10)

tools.name: get_disc
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific disc by numeric ID or string slug, including flight ratings, stability score, flight class, flight tag, available plastics, and current market rank.

tools.name: compare_discs
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 discs side-by-side, computing exact flight rating deltas and stability spread relative to the primary baseline disc.

disc_ids.description: Array of 2 to 4 disc IDs or slugs to compare

tools.name: find_similar_discs
tools.description: Find alternative replacement discs matching a target disc's category, speed, and flight profile based on weighted Euclidean flight distance.

disc_id.description: Target disc ID or slug to find replacements for

target_brand.description: Optional target brand filter for cross-brand replacements (e.g. find Discraft alternative to Innova TeeBird)

exclude_same_brand.description: If true, exclude discs from the same manufacturer

limit.description: Maximum number of similar discs to return (1..20, default 5)

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List and filter disc golf manufacturers/brands in the database, including active mold counts, speed ranges, category breakdowns, and top popular molds.

query.description: Search query to match brand name or slug (e.g. 'Axiom', 'Latitude', 'Innova')

category.description: Filter brands that manufacture discs in this category (putter, midrange, fairway_driver, distance_driver)

min_discs.description: Minimum number of active molds manufactured by the brand

limit.description: Maximum number of brands to return (1..100, default 20)

tools.name: get_flight_matrix
tools.description: Generate a 2D Speed vs Stability Flight Grid for any brand, category, or specific speed rating, grouping discs into understable, straight, stable, overstable, and very overstable columns.

category.description: Filter matrix by disc category (putter, midrange, fairway_driver, distance_driver)

speed.description: Filter matrix to a specific speed rating (e.g. 7 or 9)

tools.name: get_weekly_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the latest weekly disc golf retail sales rankings (Top 10) and weekly top risers/fallers by region (global, europe, americas, oceania, asia) based on aggregated sales from 40+ worldwide retailers.

limit.description: Number of top discs to return (1..10, default 10)

tools.name: compare_regional_rankings
tools.description: Compare up to five published discs in one category across two distinct regions on the same weekly snapshot date. Returns category positions, separate overall ranks, row counts, shared molds, and public sources.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Retrieve rolling 4-week disc golf market movers including biggest disc risers, fallers, breakout discs entering the top 100, and brand momentum shifts.

limit.description: Maximum number of mover items to return per category (1..20, default 10)

tools.name: get_disc_ranking
tools.description: Retrieve a specific disc golf disc's current weekly retail sales rank across regions (Global, Europe, Americas, Oceania, Asia) and its 4-week market momentum status.
